The base/rank fiber calculation gives an identity in K_0(Var_k) valid in all characteristics. Component equations and dimensions are derived separately for the five exhaustive coefficient-vanishing cases. The exceptional odd-characteristic fourth-root case has an irreducible c!=0 open chart and one distinct linear component, with a polynomial separating them. The independent C11 monomial-multiplication enumerator exhaustively reproduces predictions for GF(2), GF(3), GF(4), GF(5), GF(13), and GF(17), including 3rd-,4th-,8th-,12th-order resonances. Finite tests corroborate, but the proof handles arbitrary fields.

value.rationale: The exact reduced square-zero variety of a natural small asymmetric quantum complete intersection is a structural algebraic-geometric invariant, not a normalization exercise. The theorem gives an exhaustive motivic and geometric resonance phase diagram involving orders 3 (in characteristic 2), 4, 8, and 12, with dimension and component-number jumps and uniform finite-field enumeration. These invariants are neither automatic from the parent homological theory nor routine small-field data, and the rank-varying fibration gives a method for studying larger truncations.
